author: root
source: N006 Definition3.10, Lemmas2.3/3.11-3.15 and Theorem3.16; exact literal corrections remain separate.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty type sets S,I; groups may be infinite.
Flag-transitive coset geometries alpha,beta; no faithful action assumed.
Specified actual B->Aut(A) and compatible action on the indexed type set, including when subgroup labels coincide.
For every H,K and every B-type orbit representative, B_H*x intersects B_K*x = B_(H union K)*x.
Residual connectedness, firmness and thinness conclusions have the separately stated hypotheses.

proof_checks.finding: Flag transitivity gives a common representative for a flag together with one incident object, and for each incident pair in the residue. Thus the actual residue is the coset geometry on A_E.
A path stays in the cosets represented by the subgroup generated by the maximal parabolics; conversely generator multiplication produces a path. Rank at least two is essential and explicitly stated.

Induction on missing types includes the zero-type A_S base and one-type tautology. For a nonempty family, every minimal parabolic needed at the intersection appears in some member, and A_S is present. This repairs the literal empty-generated-support problem without assuming A_S=1.

Every support complement is stable under its indicated B_J. Coordinate intersection combines A-subscripts by union; IPO combines old supports by intersection within disjoint B-orbits. Empty J yields E=empty and full G; full J yields E=S and A_S semidirect B_I.

Project all cosets to B and apply the proved coset-Helly lemma; translate the common b to1. Each coset then has representative(a,1) and is a Cartesian A-parabolic coset times its B-parabolic. Pairwise incidence gives pairwise intersections in A, to which the same Helly lemma applies. No unproved orbit property is used for this part.

proof_checks.part: residual generation, only old types missing
proof_checks.finding: All A-parts are A_S; B residual generation provides the whole B_J. At least two old types are missing, matching the B criterion.

proof_checks.part: residual generation, only orbit types missing
proof_checks.finding: Choose two missing disjoint orbits. The next subscripts E union L and E union M intersect in E; both contain B_I. The join lemma gives A_E.

The orbit-type next parabolic contains the entire copy B_J. It conjugates A_Eprime from an old-type next parabolic. Every smaller support B_(J+i)*x contains x and lies within B_J*x, so its B_J saturation equals B_J*x. The intersection of all conjugate subscripts is exactly E. Finitely many distinct subsets suffice for the join lemma, even when B_J is infinite.

At old types the A-parts agree; at orbit types the B-parts agree. The exact panel indices follow. B_I*x contains x, so the A minimal parabolic embeds into the larger panel group; firmness follows. Thin inputs plus B_I fixing each chosen x give all indices2 without requiring trivial A_S.

The subgroup index factors through A semidirect B_I, giving [A:A_S]*[B:B_I] as nonzero cardinalities. For finite nonempty type sets, elements and chambers are simultaneously finite because every element extends to a chamber.

The earlier chamber-propagation and residue arguments provide A_E=A(S minus E), trivial Borels and exact panel involutions. The theorem gives a regular action with trivial chamber stabilizer; propagation proves it is the full type-preserving automorphism group.

scope_qualifications: The proof covers all nonempty finite type sets and possibly unfaithful/infinite acting groups.
Source flag-transitive coset incidence systems are geometries: any flag maps to its standard flag and extends inside the standard chamber. The input-geometry wording does not lose those cases.
Faithful-quotient replacement does not automatically preserve the action on A or on its types. The stated sufficient thinness condition uses only the Borel action on the chosen types.
No review of the later quotient or orbital-presentation sections is newly claimed by this bounded pass.
No full N006 application, sporadic certificate, lamplighter conclusion, source credit or Lean review is included.
prior_countermodels: Exact independently frozen corrections packet is bound in bindings.json; its examples remain compatible with the corrected theorem.
